description: Copy one or more animations into the Expo project as source files (shadcn-style). Files go to src/components/<id>/ (or components/<id>/, or componentsPath from nativeanimation.json). Never overwrites differing files unless overwrite is true. Missing packages are reported as an `npx expo install ...` command; set install_dependencies to run it. Returns the import line to use.

dry_run.description: Report what would change without writing.

install_dependencies.description: Run `npx expo install` for missing packages.

path.description: Destination directory, relative to the project root.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the Expo project. Defaults to the directory the MCP server was started in.

name: add_piece
title: Add animation to the project
